activities.name: Climbing Mount Fuji
activities.note: climbing above the 5th stations outside the official season is prohibited by law - the trails are unmaintained, the huts shut, and the mountain carries snow and ice

windows.reason: the official climbing season: trails, mountain huts and transport all open. The Yoshida and Subashiri trails usually open 1 July, Fujinomiya and Gotemba around 10 July
the season ends around 10 September and everything closes behind it

activities.name: Cherry blossom (sakura)
activities.note: a two-week bloom rather than a season, forecast afresh each year - a given tree holds its flowers for about ten days

windows.reason: on the 1991-2020 average Tokyo's benchmark tree reaches full bloom around 31 March, with Kyoto and Osaka three to five days later; the bloom front then moves north through April

activities.name: Skiing in Hokkaido and Nagano
activities.note: Hokkaido's summers are cool and dry rather than hot and humid, which is a different reason to go and not a skiing one

windows.reason: the most reliable months for the light, dry powder snow
the edges of a season that runs from mid-December to early March; late-season snow turns heavier and wetter

activities.name: Autumn colour (koyo)
activities.note: the front runs the opposite way to the cherry blossom — south from Hokkaido rather than north from Kyushu

windows.reason: maples and larches turn from Hokkaido, which peaks in mid-to-late October, to central Honshu and Kyoto in mid-to-late November
the last colour, in western Honshu, Shikoku and Kyushu, can last into early December

activities.name: Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route
activities.note: the mountain route shuts for the winter under deep snow

windows.reason: the route opens in mid-April and the Yuki-no-Otani snow walls line the road into June
summer and autumn on the open route, which shuts for winter on 30 November
a week of snow and ice sculptures in early February, at Odori Park, Susukino and Tsudome
Kyoto's festival runs all July; the great float processions are on 17 and 24 July, with street-party evenings before each

activities.name: Snorkelling in Okinawa
activities.note: hardier snorkellers go in all year

windows.reason: water and air are usually comfortable for snorkelling from May to October
